description: Projects Fitness (CTL, 42-day), Fatigue (ATL, 7-day) and Form (TSB) for planned training days: the same model and constants as get_training_load, rolled forward from today's values. Give each planned day's training stress as `tss` (the unit get_training_load shows per day: a typical hour of easy training is about 40-60, a hard one 80-100+); a date left out of `days` between today and the last planned day is a rest day (tss 0). Starts from the state at the end of `asOf` (default today) read with get_training_load's own computation (one workouts request, warm-up included); every planned date must be after asOf, and asOf must not be in the future, so to plan today pass yesterday as asOf. Workouts already in the account after asOf are not read: list them in `days`. Output (numbers to 1 decimal): { asOf, start: { ctl, atl, tsb }, series: [{ date, tss, ctl, atl, tsb }] (one per day from the day after asOf to the last planned day, values at the end of each day), notes }. A projection of the model, not a prediction of how you will respond; CTL can be about 1 point off the watch. At most 120 days after asOf. Read-only: it writes nothing.

asOf.description: The last local day whose workouts are counted as done, YYYY-MM-DD (default today; not in the future). The projection starts the day after.

days.description: The planned days, in any order, one entry per date.

tss.description: The day's total planned training stress (all sessions of that day together).

name: forecast_training_load
title: Forecast training load (CTL/ATL/TSB) for planned days
